title: oberna multifida
intro: Oberna multifida, commonly known as the Purple Haze or African Violet, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oberna multifida include its ability to reduce inflammation, ease pain, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
